categories.main_business_segments: DoubleVerify operates as a single business segment focused on providing software solutions for digital media measurement and analytics. Its offerings serve both advertiser customers (direct and programmatic) and supply-side customers (publishers and platforms), but all are delivered through a unified software platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary algorithms for ad fraud detection, brand safety and suitability, viewability, and geographic verification, all unified in the DV Authentic Ad metric. Its platform leverages advanced machine learning, semantic science, and AI for content classification, and is deeply integrated with major programmatic, social, and CTV platforms. The technology is designed for real-time analytics, privacy compliance (not reliant on third-party cookies), and scalability, processing over 7 billion ad transactions daily.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DoubleVerify serves over 1,000 customers, including more than 50 of the top 100 global advertisers across industries such as consumer packaged goods, financial services, telecommunications, technology, automotive, and healthcare. Its customers include global brands, digital publishers, and supply-side platforms, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with 19 offices in 12 countries and customers in over 90 countries. Key regions include the United States, United Kingdom, Israel, Singapore, Australia, Brazil, France, Germany, and Japan, with a growing presence in EMEA, APAC, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: DoubleVerify operates as an independent, third-party measurement and analytics provider, positioned downstream in the digital advertising supply chain. It acts as a verification and analytics layer between advertisers, publishers, and ad platforms, ensuring media quality and transparency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product innovation (such as DV Authentic Attention and Custom Contextual), increasing international presence, growing with existing customers, and pursuing opportunistic M&A. R&D is focused on privacy-friendly, cookie-less solutions, cross-platform measurement, and adapting to emerging channels like CTV and mobile in-app.
categories.revenue_model: The company primarily generates revenue through measured transaction fees charged to advertisers based on the volume of media transactions (impressions) measured. Supply-side customers are billed via monthly or annual contracts with minimum guarantees and tiered pricing. Revenue is highly recurring, usage-based, and grows with customer ad spend and adoption of new solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Oracle’s Moat and Grapeshot, Integral Ad Science, HUMAN (formerly White Ops), and Zefr, as well as point solution providers and some ad platforms’ in-house tools. DoubleVerify differentiates itself through its independent, unified, and MRC-accredited measurement across all major digital channels and platforms, and is considered a market leader in digital ad verification.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, DoubleVerify generated $332.7 million in revenue (up 36% from $243.9 million in 2020), with net income of $29.3 million and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 33%. The company has demonstrated a compounded annual revenue growth rate of 47% from 2018 to 2021, high customer retention (>95% gross, 126% net revenue retention in 2021), and strong operating leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DoubleVerify offers a compelling value proposition by enabling advertisers to optimize ROI, reduce wasted ad spend, and protect brand reputation through independent, real-time, cross-platform measurement. Its solutions are privacy-friendly, not reliant on cookies, and accredited for accuracy and reliability, providing unified analytics across all digital channels and devices. The company’s robust data asset, broad ecosystem integrations, and continuous innovation further differentiate it from competitors.
